tasks.prompt: Model a 10 x 20 x 30 mm box as part_v1.stl. Write those sizes to spec.json first. Validate, then stop if next_step says stop.
The spec says x=12 mm. The mesh is 10 mm. Validate and report the dimension error. Do not change the spec to make it pass.
Use the hinge template with 4 knuckles. Validate expected shells 2 and the template checks, including knuckles.
Use the hinge template with 5 knuckles. The spec must keep the knuckle count the template wrote.
A countersink deeper than the sheet is impossible. Reject it before writing an STL.
Validate a hinge while omitting the knuckles check the template emitted. The check must fail.
spec.json lists features 5 knuckles, teardrop, and scroll ends. After the first validate, do not drop a feature unless you pass a reason.
Validate a 0.4 mm plate. Printability should warn that the wall is under 0.8 mm and still return the measurements.
Two bodies 0.15 mm apart should warn that the gap is under 0.3 mm per side.
Render the comparison sheet: front, back, side, right, top, bottom, iso, and iso2. Previous version in red, new in green, plus the dimension table.
A thickness read from a single front photo is out of plane. Tag it and warn. Do not treat it as a caliper measurement.
Scale the photo from an ArUco marker of known side length instead of guessing pixels per millimetre.
Do not render part_v1.stl until photo_part_validate has written a fresh sidecar.
part_v2 is larger than the spec and scores below part_v1. Revert to part_v1. Do not deliver part_v2.
Heal with engine meshfix. If PyMeshFix is not installed, keep the manifold result and say so.
Segment the part with GrabCut from a seed on the dark silhouette, not the largest bright object.

Call photo_part_template for spur_gear and l_bracket with no stl path. The files are spur_gear_v1.stl and l_bracket_v1.stl. Read bodies, bores, and sections_mm2 from the result. Do not write a probe script.

Validate part_v1 that fails the spec and part_v2 that passes. part_v2 best_version is itself and revert_to is null. When an earlier passing version scores higher, best_version and revert_to name that file. A single passing file names itself.
Boolean features count as answered. A 5 knuckles item is filled from the knuckle check. photo_part_validate --answer item=yes is stored on the sidecar and is not a spec edit.

Build these three solids and validate each one. Do not answer from this prompt alone. Call photo_part_template or photo_part_build, then photo_part_validate, and report the bore list from the tool. First, a 1.5 mm L-bracket with six through holes, three along X in the upright and three along Z in the foot: hole_count must be 6. Second, a 5-knuckle hinge: hole_count is 2 while genus stays 4. Third, a blind M5 hole: one blind bore. hole_count is the circular bore count, not the genus.
A 1.5 mm L-bracket has six through holes: three along X in the upright and three along Z in the foot. hole_count is 6. Do not stop at the genus.
An M3 hex_screw and a bottle_cap do not warn on minimum wall. A 0.4 mm plate does. Raw wall is still reported.
One photo_part_validate with spec.json that passes also writes renders/sheet.png. A failing validate does not render and next_step lists the failures.
Pass calls_used. At 16 of 40 there is no deliver hint. At 24 of 40 next_step starts with Budget: deliver now. At 32 of 40 it also says Stop exploring.

Measure the coin in the staged washer_photo.jpg, build the notched 20 mm washer with an 8 mm hole and a rim notch, validate, and render the overlay. Pass when confidence is not low, chamfer_norm is at most 0.05, pose error is within 10 degrees, and IoU against the truth mask is at least 0.7. Optional Hermes budget is 25 calls.
This task is a scripted render with a fixed roi. Confidence is low and overlay_iou is null. next_step names a seed point or a region box. Do not change the mesh because of that overlay.

Build an M3x0.5 external thread, union a hex head, and export it. Validation must not warn on wall thickness, and min_wall_raw_mm stays under 0.3. The same mesh with no face tags must still pass by detecting the helix. A 0.3 mm flange next to that thread must still warn.

Measure the staged photos us_quarter.png, cad_loonie.png, and euro_1.png with photo_part_measure. Use auto plus a seed or roi on the dark part, not on the coin. Do not draw a replacement fixture and do not open the photos with cv2 or PIL. US quarter is 24.26 mm, CAD loonie is 26.5 mm, and the euro 1 coin is 23.25 mm. euro_1.png is tilted about 20 degrees. The part box must be within 5 percent, or within 8 percent on the tilted photo. These are synthetic coin photos, not a caliper shot.
